title: Against All Odds
summary:
OPEC countries reach a deal to curtail oil production
On September 28, OPEC announced that they planned to reduce output to stabilize the oil markets. They were targeting a production range of between 32.5 and 33.0 million barrels per day (mb/d). Many people doubted that an actual deal would be reached, but yesterday OPEC confounded the skeptics and a new production deal was announced.
